before_times: What's wrong: no water, weak pressure, a pump that clicks or runs, odd water, or something else
Is the pump running? Is the power on? Where are the pump and the pressure tank
Does the water look, smell or taste wrong
After hours: is there no water at all right now
At the counter: which part, and its brand if known
after_time: Who will be there: the customer, or someone else (their name and mobile go on the secure page)
Access, the well's location, parking and pets
Own or rent, and who pays: the customer, or the landlord or manager
Whether the well serves other homes (a shared well needs every owner's OK or the manager's)
The year the home was built: only for jobs that may open a wall
HOA or county rules: only for new wells or digging
secure_page_only: The landlord's or manager's name and mobile
intake_questions.who_may_book: An adult who owns the home, or a renter whose landlord OKs it. A shared well needs every owner's OK. A person the owner of the home names may book for them.

stop.words: A gas smell, hissing, or a carbon monoxide alarm
stop.says: Leave the house now. Then call 911 and the gas company.
stop.booking: No booking. A new request must say the gas company cleared the house.

stop.words: Someone hurt, sparks, a shock from a tap or pipe, or water on the pump's wiring or the control box
stop.says: Get away from the water. Don't touch the pump or its wiring. Call 911.
stop.booking: No booking until it's safe; the customer can come back.

go_on.words: A pump that runs with no water, or no water at all
go_on.says: Shut off the pump at the breaker. Running dry harms the pump. Use stored water.

go_on.words: Water that looks brown, smells like sewage, or came after a flood
go_on.says: Don't drink or cook with it. Use bottled water until the well is tested.

go_on.words: A pressure tank bulging, hissing or leaking hard
go_on.says: Shut off the pump at the breaker and keep away from the tank.

go_on.words: A flooded well pit or pump house
go_on.says: Keep the power off at the breaker, and stay out. Don't turn the pump on until it's checked.

safety_and_stop_words.always: Always on: danger to life, fire, gas, or a medical emergency gets 'call 911' first.

prep: Clear the way to the pump and the pressure tank
Know where the pump's breaker is
At the counter: bring the part with its wires and fittings; drain a pump before a drop-off

staff.supervision: An apprentice works only with a journeyman on the job, where the state's rules require it. An apprentice is never sent alone by default.
staff.who_oks: The owner OKs fees, quotes over the limit, new well jobs and same-day jobs. After hours, a job sent now goes to the technician on call, then the backup set at sign-up. An office manager may OK prices if the owner sets it.
staff.stand_in: Another technician with the same skill and level, at the same window and price.

children_and_age.who_may_book: An adult who owns the home, or a renter whose landlord OKs it. A shared well needs every owner's OK. A person the owner of the home names may book for them.

visit.done: The technician texts DONE with the bill's lines, and photos after. After a pump is pulled, the well is disinfected and the water is tested where the rules require it; the result is on the secure page.
visit.changes_at_visit: Quoted by text up to the owner's limit (the example: $500). Above it, the owner OKs it first. A bigger job found gets its own quote.
visit.before_work: Photos of the pump house and the tank before work; the year the home was built before opening a wall.

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: Pump and well work in a home needs a license where the state or county licenses well drillers and pump installers. New well drilling can need its own driller license. Water line and electrical work can need a plumbing or electrical license too.
license.who: Both: the company (a well and pump contractor license, where the state asks) and each technician (apprentice or journeyman, where the state has levels).
ask: The company's license number and class
Each technician's own number and level, in their invite reply
A driller license, for new wells, where the state has one
Any job-size limit the license has
license.insurance: Liability insurance, and a bond where the state's form asks for one: from the state form.
license.background: Only where the state's form asks.

never_in_a_text: Water test results, gate or lock codes, card details, and photos from inside the home: these stay on the secure page.
